messages:
Eli J: quick pulse  saw a bump in MQLs tied to the March webinar cohort on the weekly KPI board. can analytics confirm it's not a duping or smoothing artifact? :wave:

Maya T: will dig in. initial look: badge rate up but form completions steady. there was a webhook retry storm on 2024-03-20 that might cause duplicate event counts in streaming metrics.

Sam R: we had an ingress outage and retries at ~2024-03-20T03:12Z. idempotency keys were honored at ingestion but the streaming aggregator used raw events before dedupe. ops put a fix in at 03:45Z.

Eli J: ok can we surface a de-duped series and add an annotation to the KPI dashboard to prevent exec confusion? also flag any messaging variant lift separately.

Priya K: note: the post-webinar nurture used two subject variants. variant-2 got a higher open rate and likely moved some leads offline (manual imports), which won't show in streaming counts. need a reconciled view.

Maya T: adding normalized/deduped line. SQL to compute deduped daily leads (using idempotency key):
```sql
SELECT event_date, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(idempotency_key, event_id)) AS deduped_leads
FROM raw_webhooks
WHERE event_date BETWEEN '2024-03-18' AND '2024-03-22'
GROUP BY event_date;
```

Sam R: kicked a backfill of the streaming aggregates to apply dedupe and smoothing correction. job: `airflow trigger_dag streaming_agg_backfill --conf '{"start":"2024-03-18","end":"2024-03-22"}'`. ETA ~70m.

dashbot: KPI board updated with temporary annotation: "streaming ingress retry storm; dedupe backfill in progress" (id: a-20240320-retry). public: https://dash.redwood.com/r/kpi-weekly

Eli J: thanks. once backfill + reconciled snapshot ready, please post a short note with the corrected numbers and a brief blurb about messaging variant vs ingestion artifact. want to avoid noisy exec pings. :thumbsup:
